The GSE Coach-Mind v2.0 enforces a strict separation between internal coach logic and external bookmaker signals. This is realized through a tri-zone architecture: Zone 1 isolates raw inputs, Zone 2 seals internal states using Merkle roots and cryptographic receipts, and Zone 3 performs read-only inspection of external lines. The core innovation lies in treating games as causal systems driven by coach decisions rather than priced derivatives. The entropy-regularized transport mechanism ensures that mid-week injury updates are handled with minimal variance, preserving the integrity of the underlying model. The sealed EPA dropoff table prevents retroactive changes to injury impact modeling, maintaining a consistent probabilistic baseline. These primitives form a closed-loop system where external data is treated as a noisy signal, not a control variable.
